summary:
Closing turn: the focus is released with the record standing as it is, and the one execution this cycle confirmed the environment observation in the clean copy.

What the run established, in final form. Twelve claim families with executed artifacts: nine confirmed violations or consequences — C1 (a recovery ignores a reply reporting the instance COMMITTED and commits a NOOP vector for it, on a driven proposal/commit history), C3 (the same divergence reaching the applied state on that history), C2 (the durable metadata record loses the bal value it writes), C4 (a legal NOOP commit terminates a restarted owner through a nil dereference, on a constructed history), C6 (the promoted-leader variant of C1), C7 (the accept handler's rejection branch is unreachable, so a rejected round waits out the timeout), C9 (the recorder writes the recovering replica's own row's metadata, or dereferences nothing), C10 (a value beyond the 16-bit length field is truncated, displaces the following commands, panics the receiver's decoder, and makes the production peer reader exit), C11 (replica construction dereferences a failed probe dial where sockets are unavailable), C12 (the documented transitive-conflict skipping is inert) — plus two bounded no-violation protections: C5 (an owner that survives a NOOP recovery re-proposes the operation and answers the client end to end, its artifact executed but unreviewed) and C8 (the executor timeout enqueues a blocked instance and the enqueued entry starts a real recovery). The map is current at version 20 with all analysis-root files read, the confirmed mechanisms live at their coordinates, and earlier limitations retired by later scenarios rather than left standing.

What the final cycle added. The listen exploration reproduced in the clean copy exactly what the local run showed — "socket: operation not permitted" for both a loopback and an all-interfaces bind — so the environment class behind the startup-probe finding and behind the failed loop-measurement attempt is now a confirmed fact rather than an inference from a nil listener.

Why no further work was spent. Audit units and semantic reviews are exhausted, so no new obligation and no confirmation review could be produced; the frontier's remaining entries are deployment premises that decide whether three findings are live, two paused candidates with scoped resume conditions, and the attribution issue on the superseded C1 artifact that no accepted mechanism can resolve. Rather than spend the remaining experiment budget on variants of settled findings, the focus is released with the resume conditions recorded. No requirement was weakened, no history invented, and every inference boundary in the record is labelled as such.
